**Real scope is ~1200 hits in 94 files, but only the JS variable names can move.**

| Zone | Hits | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `services` (75 files) | 1200 | Rename JS vars only |
| `migrations` (12) | 61 | Do not touch. Applied history |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` (4) | 20 | Do not touch. `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | Do not touch. Frozen public contract |
| `lib/serialize.js`, `lib/audit.js` | 5 | Do not touch. Wire keys |

Three traps inside `services`. 125 SQL strings in 25 repo files name the real column `account_id`. 25 `JSON.stringify` calls write an `account_id` key into `payload` JSONB. `req.session.account_id` is a shared session shape.

A blind find-replace breaks the API and every query. Ask for the column rename plan and a dated API version first.
